Applied AI Developer - BEAM
$96,475 - $108,534 per year, based on experience | Full-Time 
United Methodist Communities Home Office| Neptune, New Jersey

Join our team at United Methodist Communities in New Jersey. This position offers $96,475 - $108,534 per year, based on experience and a hybrid work environment. 

Why UMC
United Methodist Communities has been Certified as a Great Place to Work for 9 years in a row and has proudly served New Jersey seniors for more than 100 years. Our team members feel the impact of what they do every day, with 87% saying their work makes a difference.  
  
What You'll Do:  

Build and Deploy AI Solutions
Design, build, and deploy AI agents, automations, and internal tools using Microsoft 365, Copilot Studio, Claude, OpenAI, Power Automate, Azure, and large language model APIs, connecting them to the systems where work happens such as Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, and HR, clinical, and financial data
Prototype quickly, test with the people who will use each tool, and harden what works for production use, while documenting each solution and tracking its usage, cost, and results
Requirements and Solution Design
Turn requests from leadership into clear requirements by meeting with the staff who do the work, including time on site at UMC communities, the home office, and HomeWorks
Propose a practical approach, timeline, and level of effort for each request, confirm priorities with leadership, and raise questions, risks, and improvement ideas 
Rollout, Training, and Support
Test solutions with staff before launch, refine them based on feedback, and explain how each tool works, what it can and cannot do, and how data is handled in plain language
Run demos, short trainings, and quick-reference guides for each release in partnership with BEAM’s digital literacy and adoption specialist, and continue collecting and acting on feedback after launch
BEAM Client Delivery
Adapt solutions proven at UMC for BEAM Advisors’ senior living clients, such as automation packs, AI governance tools, and assessment tools
Support BEAM advisors on client AI engagements through demos, prototypes, workshops, and technical implementation, and contribute to improvements in BEAM’s internal tools and platforms
Responsible AI, Security, and Quality 
Follow UMC’s AI governance policy, HIPAA, and information security standards in everything built, using resident, teammate, or client data only as approved
Submit solutions for security and privacy review before production use, test AI output for accuracy and failure cases, and share lessons learned through lunch-and-learn sessions and written notes

What You'll Need:  
Required

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, data science, engineering, or a related discipline
1+ year of experience building software, automations, data tools, or AI applications through employment, internships, research, or substantial independent projects, with working examples you can demonstrate
Ability to maintain any license, credential, or authorization required for assigned travel or client-site access

Preferred

Coursework or credentials in artificial intelligence or machine learning, health informatics, or business
Experience building applications with large language model APIs and agent frameworks; Microsoft Power Platform, Copilot Studio, or Microsoft Graph; and Python and JavaScript or TypeScript
Experience in healthcare, senior living, nonprofit, consulting, or another client-facing environment
Microsoft Azure, Power Platform, or Microsoft 365 certifications, or a comparable cloud, AI, or data certification

Pay and Benefits:  

$96,475 - $108,534 per year, based on experience
Health, dental, and vision insurance  
Group Life and Voluntary Life Insurance 
Tuition Assistant, Professional Development and E-Learning 
Generous Paid Time Off and 9 Paid Holidays 
Retirement Plan with Employer Match 
Employee Assistance & Discount Programs 
Schedule and Location
Full-Time
Based at Home Office (located in New Jersey), hybrid work arrangement with regular on-site collaboration at communities and periodic travel to client locations as business needs require
How to Apply
Apply in about 5 minutes. We review applications on a rolling basis.

To apply, please complete the required questionnaire. We accept applications on a rolling basis.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and are committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, veteran or military status, citizenship status, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation, and related conditions), political affiliation, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. If you require accommodations during the interview process, please let us know. Reasonable accommodations will be provided upon request to ensure equal opportunity for all applicants.

Applicants for this position must be able to produce a negative drug test. Applicants may be subject to a background check. Employees in this position must be able to satisfactorily perform the essential functions of the position. If requested, this organization will make every effort to provide reasonable accommodations to enable employees with disabilities to perform the position’s essential job duties. As markets change and the Organization grows, job descriptions may change over time as requirements and employee skill levels evolve. With this understanding, this organization retains the right to change or assign other duties to this position.

E-Verify Participation
United Methodist Communities participates in E-Verify.
This employer will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), with information from each new employee’s Form I-9 to confirm work authorization.
